items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: All corrected ACs implemented: --driver required with no default, {glm,openai}/{glm,opus} roster swap, identity-locked opus leg (CLI+OpenRouter), marker schema 5, 8 prose call sites, contract test; no scope beyond spec (generic multi-driver framework explicitly rejected).

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: review_claude_cli wraps subprocess.run in TimeoutExpired/OSError/JSONDecodeError handlers, returns explicit status/reason dicts on every failure path; resolve_opus_route names the exact unavailability reason rather than a generic state.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: Diff/spec content never reaches argv for the claude_cli leg (stdin only) closing the BatBadBut risk; .cmd/.bat shim refused outright; --strict-mcp-config (empty) + --allowedTools "" close the tool-use/prompt-injection surface; no secrets/tokens added; n/a for auth (internal CLI tool, no user-facing routes).

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: 33 new tests (25 opus-leg unit + 8 driver-dispatch) assert on outcomes (subprocess argv shape, route resolution, roster dispatch), not internals; happy-path and failure-path both covered; one test caught and fixed a real isolation gap (a test that silently invoked the real installed claude CLI).

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) parallel dispatch, same pattern as the pre-existing GLM/openai pair; no new loops over unbounded data, no new blocking I/O in a hot path.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: New module external_review_opus_leg.py (224 lines) kept sibling-to, not folded into, the already-300+-line external_review_default_legs.py per the mini-plan's own LOW finding. external_review.py grew 413->469 lines (pre-existing grandfathered exception, ADR-119-style) -- bumped shipwright_bloat_baseline.json's current to 469 in this same change, verified via anti_ratchet_check.py (exit 0, no ratchets). All other touched files stay under or at their existing ceiling (sub-iterate-runner.md trimmed back to exactly its 497-line exception baseline).

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Two boundaries per the spec's own table: external_review.json's new opus_leg/models.claude_cli/models.openrouter_opus keys (existing JSON config path, exercised by the full test suite -- no new serialized format); external_review.py's new --driver CLI arg (argparse, exercised by 8 dispatch tests). Neither introduces a user-edited or hand-authored serialization needing a dedicated round-trip probe beyond the existing config-loading test coverage.
